_note: Trait values are still NOT fully verified (see docs/crop-traits-verification.md). Each crop's `sources` maps a trait to the reference ids in `sourceRefs` that support it; a trait missing from `sources` is unverified. 1-5 scales are Greenline's own scales mapped from the sources. Names and descriptions live in /content/i18n under crops.<id>.

sourceRefs.fao-cwn: FAO, Irrigation Water Management Training Manual No. 3: Crop Water Needs, Tables 4-5. https://www.fao.org/3/s2022e/s2022e02.htm
sourceRefs.fao-56: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Chapter 8, Table 22 (max effective rooting depth). https://www.fao.org/3/x0490e/x0490e0e.htm
sourceRefs.sare-mccp: SARE, Managing Cover Crops Profitably, Chart 2: Performance and Roles. https://www.sare.org/wp-content/uploads/chart2-performance-and-roles.pdf
sourceRefs.nrcs-cowpea: USDA NRCS, Cowpea Crop Fact Sheet. https://www.nrcs.usda.gov/sites/default/files/2024-04/Cowpea%20Crop%20Fact%20Sheet.pdf
sourceRefs.agrilife-sesame: Texas A&M AgriLife, Expanded Sesame Opportunities in Texas (2022). https://agrilife.org/texasrowcrops/2022/03/04/expanded-sesame-opportunities-in-texas/
sourceRefs.fao-shortage: FAO, Irrigation Water Management (T7202E), Ch. 2, Table 1: sensitivity of field crops to water shortages. https://www.fao.org/4/t7202e/t7202e05.htm
sourceRefs.sare-rye: SARE, Managing Cover Crops Profitably: Cereal Rye. https://www.sare.org/publications/managing-cover-crops-profitably/nonlegume-cover-crops/cereal-rye/
sourceRefs.sare-sudan: SARE, Managing Cover Crops Profitably: Sorghum-Sudangrass. https://www.sare.org/publications/managing-cover-crops-profitably/nonlegume-cover-crops/sorghum-sudangrass/
sourceRefs.sare-vetch: SARE, Managing Cover Crops Profitably: Hairy Vetch. https://www.sare.org/publications/managing-cover-crops-profitably/legume-cover-crops/hairy-vetch
sourceRefs.ssare-tx-cover: Southern SARE, In Drought-stricken Texas, Researchers are Finding Water Conservation Solutions in Cover Crops (GS15-152, Texas Tech). https://southern.sare.org/news/in-drought-stricken-texas-researchers-are-finding-water-conservation-solutions-in-cover-crops/

_fields.seasonalWaterMm: [min, max] seasonal crop water need in mm (FAO). Scoring maps the midpoint to a 1-5 water-need scale.
_fields.droughtSensitivity: 1-5 from FAO water-shortage class: Low 1, Low-Medium 2, Medium-High 4, High 5 (5 = very sensitive).
_fields.nFixLbPerAcre: [min, max] lb N/acre/yr fixed (SARE). [0, 0] for non-legumes, null when unknown. Used for the fertilizer-saved estimate.
_fields.contractOnly: true when the crop is normally grown only under a buyer contract.
_fields.regionalFit: "common" or "uncommon" for North Texas Blackland Prairie.
_fields.estimates: Traits whose values are unverified estimates; estimateNotes lists partial sources.
_fields.proxies: Traits taken from a related FAO crop group.
_fields.lateKillRisk: true when killing the cover crop late can deplete soil moisture (SARE).
_fields.dryYearEvidence: true when a Texas study showed steady yields in a dry year without reducing soil water for the next crop.
